entries.title: Family BINGO
entries.description: We will be running multiple rounds, so you can drop in and play anytime.
entries.priorTitleZh: 家庭 BINGO 宾果游戏
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 活动将进行多轮，欢迎随时到场参与。

entries.title: Holiday Jazz Music
entries.description: They will perform popular holiday music, including songs such as "Jingle Bells," "Frosty the Snowman," "Let It Snow," “Rockin’ Around the Christmas Tree,” and others.
entries.priorDescriptionZh: MAK Band Jazz 将带来节日热门歌曲合唱演出。乐队包括吉他、尤克里里、小号、次中音和中音萨克斯、单簧管、长号、贝斯、鼓、口琴、打击乐及特邀爵士音乐家，将演奏《Jingle Bells》《Frosty the Snowman》《Let It Snow》《Rockin’ Around the Christmas Tree》等曲目。这是一场家庭活动。

entries.title: Baby Sign and Sing
entries.description: Adult Caregivers will learn basic signs to communicate with their babies.
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 欢迎到图书馆一楼活动室参加宝宝手语与歌唱活动。

entries.title: Winter Magic Show with Magician Mike Della Penna
entries.description: Come warm yourself this season with a little fun and a whole lot of wonder at a magic show inspired by the most magical season of the year, a time of shorter days, colder nights, and annual celebrations of light!
entries.priorTitleZh: 魔术师 Mike Della Penna 冬季魔术秀
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 在这个白昼渐短、夜晚变冷、充满灯光庆典的季节，欣赏一场以冬季魔幻氛围为灵感的魔术表演，享受欢乐与惊奇。

entries.title: Domingos de Matiné con merienda
entries.description: After the movie, there will be a brief discussion about the movie’s history, its making and themes.
entries.priorTitleZh: 周日电影与点心（Domingos de Matiné con merienda）
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 电影结束后将简短讨论影片的历史、制作过程和主题。观影期间提供点心。

entries.title: LEGO Club for Grades K-8
entries.description: Children will use their creativity and engineering skills to free build anything they can imagine.
entries.priorTitleZh: K–8 年级 LEGO 积木俱乐部
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 孩子们将发挥创造力与工程技能，自由搭建任何想象中的作品。可以直接到场参与。

entries.title: Growing Readers: Help Your Aspiring Writer
entries.description: A free workshop for parents and caregivers presented by Santa Clara County Office of Education and The Reading Program of Santa Clara County Library District.
entries.priorTitleZh: 培养阅读者：帮助有写作兴趣的孩子
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 这场面向家长和照护者的工作坊由 Santa Clara County Office of Education 和 Santa Clara County Library District 的 The Reading Program 举办，帮助孩子建立写作信心。

entries.title: Library Ukulele Society of Morgan Hill
entries.description: Learn some songs and play together.
entries.priorTitleZh: Morgan Hill 图书馆尤克里里社团
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 带上自己的尤克里里和谱架，也可以来聆听、跟唱。

entries.title: Story Explorers: TK-1st Grade Book Club
entries.description: We'll read together, have a short discussion of each book, move to music, and end with a fun craft!
entries.priorTitleZh: 故事探索者：TK–1 年级读书会
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 参加者无需提前读完图书。大家会一起阅读、简短讨论每本书、跟着音乐活动，并以有趣的手工结束。

entries.title: Virtual Author Talk: Robin Ha
entries.description: This book uses comic‑style recipes to show simple steps, helpful tips, and tasty dishes, giving beginners and seasoned cooks a playful way to learn Korean cuisine at home.
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 如需填写表格方面的帮助，可联系当地公共图书馆工作人员，致电 (408) 540-3947，或发送电子邮件至 ask@lib.sccgov.org。

entries.title: Poetry in the Dark
entries.description: Let’s gather to listen deeply, celebrate difference, and honor the many languages that shape our community.
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 今年十二月，在 Cupertino Library 的柔和灯光下参加诗歌分享之夜。不同年龄、文化和语言背景的人通过口头与书面诗歌交流。参与者可向小组朗读自己的诗作。由 Cupertino 桂冠诗人 Thomas Célérier 主持。欢迎大家参加，无需相关经验。

entries.title: Cozy Creators
entries.description: Parents, you'll love it because your kids get to make beautiful seasonal treasures, and the glittery aftermath stays safely at the library—not all over your home.
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 欢迎来一起相聚，享受手工制作的乐趣。

entries.title: Miss Molly Bubbles
entries.description: This captivating performance will fill your eyes with wonder and laughter, creating a magical experience for all ages.
entries.priorTitleZh: Miss Molly Bubbles 泡泡表演
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 这场表演将带来令人惊叹又充满欢笑的体验，让不同年龄的观众感受奇妙氛围。由于场地有限，活动开始前 30 分钟将开始发放不收费的入场券。

entries.title: Tiny Toots Concert: Farmer Arann
entries.description: Farmer Arann will be here with his instruments, big voice, unique songs, and super fun personality!
entries.priorDescriptionZh: Farmer Arann 将带上乐器，用洪亮的歌声、独特的歌曲和活泼有趣的风格呈现演出。

entries.title: Adult & Teen Crafternoon: Felted Snowmen
entries.description: Come learn the basics of needle felting to create a cozy winter friend, from a simple snowman for beginner's to a more elaborate snow animal if you'd like to experiment!
entries.priorTitleZh: 成人与青少年手工下午：羊毛毡雪人
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 如有现场示范，将在下午 3 点活动开始时进行；之后仍有说明材料和工作人员随时回答问题。十二月的手工主题是羊毛毡雪人。

entries.title: Merry Pixie Pages
entries.description: Every rhyme, song, and story helps build the skills kids need to become confident readers.
entries.priorTitleZh: 欢乐精灵故事时间（Merry Pixie Pages）
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 每首童谣、歌曲和故事都在帮助孩子培养成为自信读者所需的技能。欢迎参加 Merry Pixie Pages，在这里萌发对阅读的热爱。

entries.title: A Look into the Night Sky with Astro Everywhere
entries.description: We’ll gather in the Treetop Room for a live astronomy show featuring planetarium software to explore the night sky as seen from Palo Alto.
entries.priorTitleZh: 与 Astro Everywhere 一起探索夜空
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 大家将在 Treetop Room 观看现场天文演示，使用天文馆软件探索从 Palo Alto 可以看到的夜空。

entries.title: Mike Della Penna: Winter Magic Show
entries.description: A magic show by magician Mike Della Penna, inspired by the most magical season of the year!

entries.title: Ugly Sweater Decorating Party!
entries.description: Get into the holiday spirit by creating your own ugly sweater!

entries.title: Pan Dulce Lotería
entries.description: Strengthen your community and join us for a lively game afternoon.

entries.title: Back to Bach presents The Berenstain Bears Meet Santa Bear
entries.description: Join us at Saratoga Library as we welcome Back to Bach present the live musical storytime of The Berenstain Bears Meet Santa Bear.

entries.title: Button Making Pop-up for Teens!
entries.description: Use old manga and comics to make a unique design or create your own from scratch.
entries.priorTitleZh: 青少年徽章制作快闪活动！
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 放学后到 Teen Zone 制作自己的徽章。

entries.title: Rinconada Book Fair
entries.description: Whether you’re a reader, writer, or simply a lover of books, this event offers the perfect opportunity to discover new voices, gain insights into writing and publishing, and celebrate local literary talent.
